title: docs(approvals): say how a request with no submitter leaves the returned state

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #29910

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:审批指南和 `IApprovalService` 的 `recall` / `sendBack` / `resubmit` 注释写明「没有提交人的审批单」被退回后怎么走出来:退回后谁也撤不回,唯一出路是服务端代码以系统上下文 `resubmit`,新一轮 `pending` 仍无提交人,系统或管理员覆盖可撤回。指南还告诉作者:由无用户触发器启动的流程,只有在服务端代码会做这次重提时才声明 `revise` 边,否则不声明,让审批人改用驳回。
- 为什么改:维护者在「第三批 同意」中选了 D(行为不变,把出路写清楚);此前文档没有说过这种审批单退回后的去向。
- 风险与回滚:只改注释和文档,外加一个 `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset;非注释的 token 前后完全一致(见 Verification),行为不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts` 的 `recall` 与 `sendBack` 注释;`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` 的「A request with no submitter」段。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`,应只看到 `*` 开头的注释行变化。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(spec 包改动,落地前席位做一次独立复审)。

## What changes

- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, under **Send-back → resubmit**: a new paragraph, **A request with no submitter**. It says that a run whose trigger resolved no user opens its request with no submitter; that an approver can still send it back, but nobody can recall it once it is `returned` and no viewer sees Resubmit or Recall; that its one way out is a system-context `resubmit` from server-side code, which opens the next round `pending`, again with no submitter, where the system or the admin override can recall it. It also says what an author should do on such a flow: keep the `revise` edge into its `approval_revise` node only when server-side code will make that resubmit, and otherwise leave the edge off, so send-back is refused and approvers reject instead. `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx` only names send-back in one line and does not teach recall or resubmit, so it is unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`, comments only:
  - `recall`: a closing paragraph saying the `returned` arm has no one for a request with no submitter, and stating the way out above.
  - `sendBack`: a closing paragraph saying such a request is sent back the same way, that only a system-context `resubmit` moves it on, and that a flow whose trigger resolves no user declares `revise` only when server-side code will make that call.
  - `resubmit`: "submitter-only" now reads "by the submitter or a system context (the system context alone on a request with no submitter)". The code already admits the system context, and `ApprovalResubmitInput.actorId` already said so.
- `.changeset/29910-no-submitter-returned-docs.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`. The docblock text ships: after a build it is in `packages/spec/dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` (positive control: the existing sentence "refused there exactly as any other non-submitter" is found in the same two files). So this is a published, comment-only change, which takes a patch changeset rather than `skip-changeset`.

### The documented path, read from code at `987ff33b`

- No submitter: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-node.ts:107-111` (`runTriggerUser`, `null` when the trigger resolved no user) feeds `submitterId` at `approval-node.ts:199`.
- Send-back is allowed and lands on the window: `approval-service.ts:6041` (pending approver or system, no submitter test) and `assertReviseEdge` at `approval-service.ts:6278-6312` (the `revise` edge must exist and must target an `approval_revise` node). `approval-revise-node.ts:89-98`: the window arms nothing, and only `resubmit` or a recall ends it.
- Nobody recalls it on `returned`: `approval-service.ts:5613-5618` (`overrideAdmits` requires `status === 'pending'`; `actsAsSubmitter` at `approval-service.ts:1114-1117` answers false for every actor when `submitter_id` is null).
- A system-context resubmit is admitted: `approval-service.ts:6202` (`if (!context.isSystem && !actsAsSubmitter(raw, actorId))`), pinned at `approval-service.test.ts:6418-6423`. Its resume carries no `resumedBy` (`approval-service.ts:6241-6248`), so the run context is not switched (`service-automation/src/run-resume.ts:326-328`). The re-entered approval node opens round N+1 through `approval-node.ts:199` again, with no submitter (also pinned for a later step by `later-step-original-submitter.integration.test.ts:322`).
- The new `pending` round is recalled by the system or the override actor: `approval-service.ts:5613-5614` with `isOverrideActor` at `approval-service.ts:2111-2113` (`context.isSystem` always passes). Pinned at `approval-service.test.ts:6403-6416`.
- No console door: `sys-approval-request.object.ts:766-778` shows Resubmit only to `viewer.is_submitter`, and Recall on `returned` only to the submitter (`can_override` is pending-only). The REST `/resubmit` route (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts:518-523`) passes the caller's own resolved context.

## Tests

No test was added: nothing a test can pin changed. The behaviour documented here is already pinned by the `approval-service.test.ts` battery cited above.

## Acceptance notes

- A system-context `resubmit` is reachable only from server-side code. The console offers no button for it, and the REST route acts as its caller. The guide says "server-side code in a system context" and does not name any other door.
- Comments-only proof: `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts` was tokenised with the TypeScript scanner (comments skipped) at `987ff33b` and at this branch. Both give 1420 tokens and the streams are identical. Control: changing one `actorId: string` to `number` makes the comparison report `false`. So no `.d.ts` statement other than a comment can move. `api-surface/contracts.json` records only the interface names, and the spec build regenerated nothing (clean `git status` afterwards).

## Verification
